name: self assisted inverse leg curl
description: A self-assisted inverse leg curl: kneel with the lower legs anchored, lower your straight body forward, then use the hamstrings and your hands as needed to return.
instructions: Kneel on padding with your lower legs secured under a stable support, and keep your hips extended.
Brace your trunk and slowly lean forward from the knees, keeping your body in a straight line from head to knees.
Place your hands in front of you to catch and assist yourself before you lose control.
Use your hamstrings to pull back toward upright kneeling, pushing lightly with your hands only as needed.
